calibration_rows: For each complete model table, one row per D/R/O/N/U category with raw outcome support, weighted observed share and weighted mean prediction. Entire table held if any class has fewer than 30 raw outcomes.
jurisdiction_rows: All 50 states plus DC. AP decisions identify the common 48-state transfer frame. CHEP decisions identify source presence and pooled holdout eligibility only; state-inference qualification is not claimed.
metric_rows: Twelve source evaluations: ten multinomial logistic estimator fits and two training-weighted marginal calculations. Numeric scores are unchanged.
